titleStmt.title: Shiji 史记 · 周赧王五十九年: introductions

div.p: The Basic Annals for 256 BC, the year in which Qin extinguished Western Zhou: the entry of the Basic Annals of Zhou under the fifty-ninth year of King Nan, and the entry of the Basic Annals of Qin under the fifty-first year of King Zhaoxiang, which record the same events from the two sides.
The row of the Table of the Six States for this year. The Table runs the states in parallel columns, one line to a state; only the states with an entry for the year appear.
